domains.definition: The highest level of the cognitive architecture: axioms, non-negotiables, core identity, universal truths, intent, integrity, the why, and the always.
domains.name: Principled

domains.definition: The map-room level: facts, logic, data, categories, strategy, systemic planning, accuracy, efficiency, the how, and the what.
domains.name: Cognitive

domains.definition: The value-and-weight level: subjective value, emotional resonance, aesthetic weight, meaning, consequence, tradeoff friction, and what it costs.
domains.name: Evaluative

domains.definition: The concrete execution level: physical action, immediate sensory feedback, material substrate, result, impact, the now, and the doing.
domains.name: Operational

drives.definition: the drive toward wholeness, coherence, reconciliation, and integration across particulars
drives.name: Unity

drives.definition: the drive toward understanding, evidence, learning, comprehension, and insight
drives.name: Wisdom

drives.definition: the drive toward life, energy, thriving, safety, health, and aliveness
drives.name: Vitality

drives.definition: the drive toward relationship, empathy, mutual attunement, and social coherence
drives.name: Connection

drives.definition: the drive toward choice, action, responsibility, control, and execution authority
drives.name: Agency

drives.definition: the drive toward order, rules, boundaries, safeguards, constraints, and system design
drives.name: Structure

drives.definition: the drive toward meaning, long-term goals, calling, direction, and larger consequences
drives.name: Purpose

honesty_boundary: The 10 Noetic definitions are verbatim canonical from CAS_FOUNDATIONAL_CLARIFICATIONS. Domains/registers/drives are the current CAS v7.5/v7.7 translation layer. The original TKS 28 Foundations source text is not fully populated in the repository.

noetics.definition: All things in and outside the Mind.
noetics.name: Idea

noetics.definition: Various degrees of awareness that processes, stores, outputs, and intakes Ideas.
noetics.name: Mind

noetics.definition: An Idea the Mind has an affinity for and is attracted toward.
noetics.name: Positive

noetics.definition: An Idea the Mind is adverse to and repelled by.
noetics.name: Negative

noetics.definition: The degree to which an Idea resonates with the Mind, its impression.
noetics.name: Vibration

noetics.definition: A Mind impregnated with an Idea, the Ideas a Mind is composed of.
noetics.name: Female

noetics.definition: An Idea impregnated with another Idea, the Ideas an Idea is composed of.
noetics.name: Male

noetics.definition: The rate and pattern a Mind is exposed to an Idea, entraining/conditioning it.
noetics.name: Rhythm

noetics.definition: An Idea that triggers a different Idea than itself to come to Mind.
noetics.name: Above/Cause

noetics.definition: The Idea brought to Mind by an Above/Cause trigger.
noetics.name: Below/Effect

registers.definition: sensorimotor, concrete, direct engagement with material or physical substrate
registers.name: Embodied
